An '''asteroid cluster''' was located in the [[Middian system|Pasaana system]].<ref name="CVNE" /> After leaving [[Pasaana]], [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], [[Finn]], [[Poe Dameron]] and [[C-3PO]] hid in the cluster in the ''[[Bestoon Legacy]]'', where they discussed Rey's apparent [[Death|killing]] of [[Chewbacca]]. Losing the dagger with Chewbacca, they chose to try the inscription on it with C-3PO's memory, but 3PO decided to go to [[Zorii Bliss]] in [[Kijimi]] to have him read a forbidden language. So the team headed towards Kijimi, with the [[Knights of Ren]] following behind them.<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
